description: The request handles its call's failure (a raw HTTP 500): no E-ERROR-002 at compile time, and the assigned cell keeps its value — the 500 body never lands in it.
rationale: §6.7.7: "The call that is the right-hand side of the body's assignment SHALL be handled by the request, and SHALL NOT be E-ERROR-002: its failure … SHALL set `<#id>.error` and leave `@var` and `<#id>.data` at their previous values".
